name: io.github.SunrisesIllNeverSee/tteop-mcp
description: TTEOP MCP Server — Build, validate, and describe TTEOP telemetry envelopes for AI operator token efficiency measurement.

tools.name: tteop_build_envelope
tools.description: Build a TTEOP v0.1-draft schema-conforming telemetry envelope from token counts. Computes Yield, Leverage, Velocity, output_fraction, and log_leverage.

tools.name: tteop_validate_envelope
tools.description: Validate a TTEOP v0.1-draft telemetry envelope against the JSON Schema and semantic rules.

tools.name: tteop_describe_protocol
tools.description: Get TTEOP protocol metadata: version, privacy modes, provenance levels, metric definitions.

tools.name: tteop_run_conformance
tools.description: Run the TTEOP conformance suite: canonical vector invariants, null semantics, forbidden field detection.
